title: mentha × rotundifolia subsp. timija
intro: Mentha × rotundifolia subsp. timija, commonly known as Indian mint or timija, is a subspecies of the peppermint plant that is native to India and other parts of Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and relieving stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Mentha × rotundifolia subsp. timija are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including menthone, limonene, and timolene, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Indian mint have been shown to have potential therapeutic applications in treating various health conditions, including neurodegenerative diseases, cardiovascular disorders, and skin infections.
